ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm wiper pre-detonation chain: shadow-copy destruction + BCD recovery sabotage (HermeticWiper / CaddyWiper / Prestige / IsaacWiper)
ucs.description: Hunts the near-simultaneous vssadmin/wbadmin shadow-delete + bcdedit recovery-disable pair that precedes every Sandworm wiper detonation (HermeticWiper, CaddyWiper, Prestige, IsaacWiper, AcidRain pivot hosts). This sequence is the signature pre-launch handshake observed in Sandworm/Seashell Blizzard wiper events against Ukrainian state, transport and energy targets since 2022.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process) as parents values(Processes.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ( (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","VSSAdmin.exe") AND Processes.process="*delete shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*/deletevalue*" OR Processes.process="*delete*{default}*")) ) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval signal=case(match(process_name,"(?i)vssadmin|wmic|wbadmin"),"shadow_delete", process_name=="bcdedit.exe","bcd_destroy")
| bin _time span=10m
| stats dc(signal) as signal_types values(signal) as signals values(cmdlines) as cmdline values(parents) as parent_cmdline min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by dest user _time
| where signal_types >= 2
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
let ShadowDelete = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete catalog")
    | project ShadowTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ShadowCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
              ShadowParent=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ShadowParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let BcdDestroy = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","/deletevalue")
         or (ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "{default}")
    | project BcdTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, BcdCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
              BcdParent=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              BcdParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
ShadowDelete
| join kind=inner BcdDestroy on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', ShadowTime, BcdTime)) <= 10
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend ChainStart = min_of(ShadowTime, BcdTime)
| project ChainStart, DeviceName, AccountName, ShadowCmd, BcdCmd, ShadowParent, BcdParent, ShadowParentCmd, BcdParentCmd
| order by ChainStart desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:

let ShadowDelete = SecurityEvent

let BcdDestroy = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","/deletevalue")
         or (CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "{default}")
    | project BcdTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, BcdCmd=CommandLine, BcdParent=ParentProcessName;
ShadowDelete

| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', ShadowTime, BcdTime)) <= 10
| where Account !endswith "$"
| extend ChainStart = min_of(ShadowTime, BcdTime)
| project ChainStart, Computer, Account, ShadowCmd, BcdCmd, ShadowParent, BcdParent
| order by ChainStart desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) ( (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"DELETE SHADOWS"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe) @CommandLine:*"delete catalog"*) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe) @CommandLine:*shadowcopy*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"/deletevalue"*)) )
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ( (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+catalog/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND regex("shadowcopy.*delete", field=CommandLine))
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|\/deletevalue)/i) )
| Action := if(regex("bcdedit", field=ImageFileName, flags="i"), "bcd_destroy", "shadow_delete")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[collect([Action, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName]), count(field=Action, distinct=true, as=distinct_actions), min(@timestamp, as=firstTime), max(@timestamp, as=lastTime)])
| distinct_actions >= 2
| sort(lastTime, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The vssadmin-delete + bcdedit-recovery-disable pair within ~10 minutes is the documented opening move of every public Sandworm wiper since 2022 (HermeticWiper/PARTYTICKET, CaddyWiper, IsaacWiper, Prestige, RansomBoggs). ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm GPO-pushed mass binary execution from compromised DC (Prestige / Industroyer2 / CaddyWiper deployment vector)
ucs.description: Detects Sandworm's signature lateral-deployment pattern: after compromising a Domain Controller, the actor weaponises Group Policy (ScheduledTasks.xml under SYSVOL) to fan a payload out to every domain-joined host within minutes. Looks for the same rare binary executing under a scheduler parent across many hosts in a tight window — the exact mechanism CERT-UA + Microsoft Threat Intelligence attribute to Seashell Blizzard for Prestige (Oct 2022), CaddyWiper (Mar 2022) and Industroyer2 pivot hosts.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime dc(Processes.dest) as host_count values(Processes.dest) as hosts values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.user) as users values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmdlines from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("taskhostw.exe","taskeng.exe","svchost.exe") (Processes.process_path="*\\Windows\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\PerfLogs\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Temp\\*") NOT Processes.process_name IN ("MpCmdRun.exe","cleanmgr.exe","CompatTelRunner.exe","sihclient.exe","UsoClient.exe","MusNotification.exe","OneDriveStandaloneUpdater.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe") by Processes.process_name Processes.process_hash _time span=15m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where host_count >= 5
| sort - host_count
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let Window = 15m;
let RecentHours = 12h;
let KnownGood = dynamic(["MpCmdRun.exe","cleanmgr.exe","CompatTelRunner.exe","sihclient.exe","UsoClient.exe","MusNotification.exe","OneDriveStandaloneUpdater.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe","WerFault.exe","taskhostw.exe"]);
let Baseline = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(RecentHours))
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("taskhostw.exe","taskeng.exe","svchost.exe")
    | summarize BaselineHosts = dcount(DeviceName) by SHA256
    | where BaselineHosts > 3;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(RecentHours)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("taskhostw.exe","taskeng.exe","svchost.exe")
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Windows\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\")
| where FileName !in~ (KnownGood)
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("schedule","Schedule") or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "taskhostw.exe"
| join kind=leftanti Baseline on SHA256
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            HostCount = dcount(DeviceName),
            Hosts = make_set(DeviceName, 50),
            Users = make_set(AccountName, 25),
            SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine),
            SampleParent = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
            by FileName, SHA256, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| where HostCount >= 5
| extend SpreadMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| where SpreadMinutes <= 30
| order by HostCount desc, FirstSeen desc

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(taskhostw|taskeng|svchost)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(Windows|PerfLogs|Users\\Public|ProgramData|Temp)\\/i
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\(MpCmdRun|cleanmgr|CompatTelRunner|sihclient|UsoClient|MusNotification|OneDriveStandaloneUpdater|GoogleUpdate|MicrosoftEdgeUpdate|WerFault|taskhostw)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([SHA256HashData, ImageFileName], function=[count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=HostCount), collect([ComputerName, CommandLine, UserName]), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| HostCount >= 5
| SpreadSec := (LastSeen - FirstSeen) / 1000
| SpreadSec <= 1800
| sort(HostCount, order=desc)
